newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DavCo Restaurants started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DavCo Restaurants started.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of DavCo Restaurants Inc with an investment rating of outperform for the intermediate and long term.

-- EVEREN analyst Dean Haskell said the average valuation for DavCo, the largest franchisee of Wendy's International Inc, has been between 80 percent and 90 percent of the S&P 500. He expects these relative valuations to reassert themselves as DavCo rebuilds earnings and investor confidence over the next several quarters.
-- Haskell set estimates for fiscal 1997 at $0.96 EPS and at $1.15 EPS for fiscal 1998.
-- DavCo is a fast food restaurant franchisee. Its stock traded up 1/8 Tuesday at 8-7/8.
